content.text:
Plan submitted covering all 18 rules. Summary of what the searches established:

**Located and mapped (14 rules):**
- **LOL-CAP** — §16.5 consequential-damages disclaimer (p0727) with confidentiality/indemnity and gross-negligence carve-outs; no monetary aggregate cap found anywhere, flagged for worker confirmation.
- **INDEMN** — full mutual regime, §§16.1–16.4 (p0716–p0726), plus recall allocation.
- **NONCOMPETE** — §8.2 "Exclusivity of Efforts" binds Ono/Affiliates on Competing Products (p0491–p0493); duration redacted.
- **EXCLUSIVITY** — Article IX supply chain (p0495–p0516) plus §8.2; inbound exclusive licences to us flagged as not-to-redline.
- **T4C** — §13.2 at-will termination by Ono (p0628), time-gated, with exit costs at p0647/p0652/p0654/p0656 and the p0492 post-exit restriction.
- **GOVLAW** — §18.3 (p0765) plus ICC three-arbitrator arbitration with demand-based Osaka/New York seat (p0748).
- **ASSIGN** — §18.9 (p0785–p0787), §18.10 Array Change in Control (p0788), CoC definition, p0322.
- **IP**, **LICENSE**, **AUDIT** (two regimes: §7.4 and §4.6(d)(ii) site audits), **WARRANTY**, **TRANSITION** (Article XIV wind-down, running in Array's favour), **RENEWAL** (term structure, no auto-renewal mechanics), **LD** (§14.3 runs in our favour — marked do-not-flag).

**Likely absent (4 rules):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT — each searched with multiple distinct phrasings; for INSURANCE and MINCOMMIT I noted the supply/quality agreements as the probable home so workers verify rather than assume.
